environmentDescription: Crystal-turquoise coral cove inspired by St. Martin's Island, framed by swaying coconut palms, white shell sandbars, and driftwood cabanas.
rescueStory: Mochi lands on a sunny coral sandbar, but her beach-cabana bridge lock sits around a solid coral corner—bank Striped lasers off angled Coconut Husk Bumpers to hit it!

mainObjective.summary: Crack 4 Armored Coconut Husk Bumpers (12 hits) and pop 3 Corner Coral Locks using deflected Striped lasers.

secondaryObjective.summary: Hit 2 Coral Locks in a single turn via a double-bumper ricochet.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color tropical board (Coconut, Mango, Mandarin, Guava, Litchi); firing a vertical Striped beam into a 45° Coconut Bumper bends the laser 90° horizontally into the side alcove!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: 4 Coconut Bumpers placed at (1,2), (1,5), (5,2), and (5,5) form a rectangular laser mirror circuit.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Sunny island breather pace (30 moves, turn-based): Serpent sunbathes along the outer reef track.

specialMechanics: 90-Degree Laser Billiards: angled Pearl-Shell Coconut Bumpers turn vertical Striped Candies into horizontal L-beams (and vice versa)!
victoryCondition: Pop all 3 Corner Coral Locks and crack 4 Coconut Bumpers within 30 moves.
failureCondition: Moves run out before reef bridge drops.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Billiard-style 90-degree laser reflection lets players snipe tucked-away locks around indestructible coral walls!

environmentDescription: Stepped coral-limestone tidepools sparkling under tropical sun with bamboo stepping posts.
rescueStory: Twin Gur-Slime Blobs are oozing across the tidepool stepping posts while Coconut Husk Bumpers guard the lagoon drains!

mainObjective.summary: Wash away 14 Sticky Slime tiles and drain 65 Lagoon Marbles to raise the driftwood causeway.

secondaryObjective.summary: Trigger 4 Wrapped Tender Coconut splash bursts.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board; Tender Coconut Wrapped bursts cleanse Slime in a plus-shaped hydro cross.

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Coconut Bumpers shield drain cols 0 and 7 until cracked or bypassed via reflected beams.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Advances at 1.8%/sec and coats 2 candies in Slime every 8s.

specialMechanics: Hydro Ricochet: banking a Blue/Coconut Striped beam off a Coconut Bumper upgrades the reflected beam into a Pressurized Hydro Jet that strips ALL Slime along its row!
victoryCondition: Clean 14 Slimes and drain 65 Lagoon Marbles before Slime Blobs coat Mochi's post.
failureCondition: Danger reaches 100%.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Elemental beam upgrade: reflecting a Coconut-colored Striped laser off a Coconut Bumper turns it into a Slime-erasing Hydro Jet!

environmentDescription: Sloping palm-lined white-sand beach boardwalk dotted with springy Rasgulla beach-umbrellas and giant coconut bumpers.
rescueStory: A Spiked Jawbreaker Boulder AND an Armored Jawbreaker Pangolin are rolling down the boardwalk ramp behind Mochi—bounce them back!

mainObjective.summary: Collect 28 Spongy Rasgulla Orbs, drop 2 Cabana Keys, and shatter the Spiked Boulder (3 Special hits).

secondaryObjective.summary: Bounce the rolling hazard backward twice using Rasgulla cushions.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color island board including `CANDY_SPONGY_RASGULLA`; every 14 Rasgullas collected deploys an automatic Bounce Cushion behind Mochi!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Keys navigate through staggered Coconut Bumpers and Crumbling Sand-Wafer tiles.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Rolls down the boardwalk at 1.95%/sec alongside the Spiked Jawbreaker.

specialMechanics: Pinball Cushion Rebound: when the Pangolin hits a deployed Rasgulla Cushion, it rebounds into the Spiked Boulder behind it, dealing 1 free Special hit to the boulder!
victoryCondition: Collect 28 Rasgullas, drop 2 Keys, and shatter the Spiked Boulder before boardwalk impact.
failureCondition: Boulder or Pangolin reaches Mochi at 100% danger.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Arena pinball physics: bouncing the lead Pangolin makes it collide with the trailing Spiked Boulder for chain-reaction damage!

environmentDescription: A narrow twin-lagoon sandbar swept by brisk sea breezes, linking two coral lighthouses with a wooden zip-trolley.
rescueStory: Brisk island crosswinds are shifting candies sideways while a Closing Lighthouse Door slowly descends ahead of Mochi's zip-trolley!

mainObjective.summary: Keep the Lighthouse Shutter >= 40% open, unlock 2 Brass Signal Trunks, and break 10 Iron Chains.

secondaryObjective.summary: Unlock both Signal Trunks with 7+ moves to spare.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color board; Row 1 blows LEFT while Row 5 blows RIGHT (`OBS_GALE_WIND_TUNNEL` counter-currents)!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Counter-rotating wind belts on rows 1 and 5 circulate candies around the 2 central Brass Signal Trunks!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Rides the wind belts in hybrid mode (25 moves / 70s) to re-chain unlocked tiles.

specialMechanics: Counter-Current Carousel: candies ride Row 1 left and Row 5 right, automatically bringing needed fruit colors into alignment with the central Brass Trunks!
victoryCondition: Open both Brass Trunks and break 10 Chains while keeping Lighthouse Shutter >= 40% open.
failureCondition: Shutter closes below 40% at move 25 or timer expiry.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Opposing left/right wind conveyor rows create a circular candy carousel around stationary color-locked chests!

environmentDescription: A flamboyant floating sweet-banquet barge anchored in a coral bay, captained by the gigantic Maharaja Gulp!
rescueStory: BOSS ENCOUNTER 3! Maharaja Gulp activates his vacuum-slurp horn, pulling whole rows of island candies—and Mochi's raft!—toward his banquet barge!

mainObjective.summary: Deplete Maharaja Gulp's 200 HP appetite bar by banking lasers off 4 Coconut Bumpers and feeding 5 Special Candies into his Mega-Slurp beam!

secondaryObjective.summary: Feed a Rainbow Color Bomb directly into a Mega-Slurp beam for an instant 60-HP Fizzy Overload!

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color island board; every 3 turns Maharaja Gulp highlights 2 columns with a golden Vacuum Beam—any Special Candy left inside those columns gets slurped for 40 Boss stun damage!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: 4 angled Coconut Bumpers allow horizontal sniping into Gulp's flank shield during non-slurp turns.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: 2-Phase Boss pulling Mochi's raft closer at 1.55%/sec with periodic 2-column Mega-Slurps.

specialMechanics: Trojan-Candy Counterattack: instead of detonating every Special immediately, parking Specials inside Maharaja Gulp's telegraphed Vacuum Columns turns his own attack against him!
victoryCondition: Reduce Maharaja Gulp's 200 HP to 0 and land 5 Fizzy Slurp counters before Mochi's raft hits the barge.
failureCondition: Raft pulled into banquet barge (Danger = 100%).
uniqueGameplayTwist: Inverts normal match-3 habits: you intentionally LEAVE Special Candies unpopped in telegraphed boss columns so the boss swallows them for massive stun damage!

environmentDescription: Rain-kissed Meghna riverbank embankment with blooming pink shapla (water-lilies), floating origami paper boats, and brass drainage pumps.
rescueStory: Monsoon rains have submerged the bottom 3 rows of the puzzle board in crystal river water—making submerged candies float UPWARD instead of falling down!

mainObjective.summary: Collect 36 Buoyant Barisal Guavas and 24 Monsoon Jamuns while mastering the Dual-Gravity Flood Line!

secondaryObjective.summary: Form 4 matches right across the Row-3 Waterline Equator.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color monsoon board introducing `OBS_MONSOON_FLOOD_TIDE`: Rows 0–3 fall DOWN toward Row 3, while submerged Rows 4–6 float UP toward Row 4!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Rows 4, 5, and 6 are underwater; candies spawn from BOTH row 0 (sky) and row 6 (riverbed) and meet in the middle!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Gentle Chapter-7 onboarding pace (29 moves) as players enjoy learning dual-gravity cascades!

specialMechanics: Waterline Convergence: because top candies fall down and bottom candies float up, rows 3 and 4 become a super-dense cascade collision zone!
victoryCondition: Harvest 36 Guavas and 24 Jamuns within 29 moves.
failureCondition: Moves expire before Mochi's paper-boat dock rises.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Dual-gravity horizon: top half falls downward while submerged bottom half floats upward, colliding at the central waterline!

environmentDescription: Wide monsoon river channel crossed by a lantern-lit covered sampan boat amidst playful glowing turquoise whirlpools.
rescueStory: A Swirling River-Current Eel is spinning mini-whirlpools around Mochi's sampan—rotating 2x2 blocks of candies clockwise every 2 turns!

mainObjective.summary: Propel Mochi's Sampan 120m to the stone ghat and free 8 Chained Buoy-Candies.

secondaryObjective.summary: Let the Eel's clockwise 2x2 spin complete a 4+ match for you twice!

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board with submerged Rows 5–6; Guava matches calm the Eel's backward current tug.

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Two glowing 2x2 Whirlpool rings at (2,1)-(3,2) and (2,5)-(3,6) rotate their 4 candies 90° clockwise every 2 moves.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Tugs ferry back 8m every 2 moves while rotating the whirlpool tiles.

specialMechanics: Predictive Spin Setup: setting 3 matching candies adjacent to a Whirlpool quadrant lets the Eel rotate the 4th candy into a free Striped/Rainbow match!
victoryCondition: Reach 120m Sampan distance and snap 8 Chains within 27 moves.
failureCondition: Moves reach 0 before docking.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Predictable clockwise 2x2 whirlpool tile rotations let clever players engineer hands-free end-of-turn combos!

environmentDescription: Submerged brick sluice-house where the escape keyholes are mounted at the WATERLINE in the middle of the board instead of the bottom!
rescueStory: The lower sluice chamber flooded! Because the Cork-Float Keys are buoyant in water, two Keys drop DOWN from the roof while two float UP from the floor toward Row 3!

mainObjective.summary: Deliver 2 Top Keys DOWN and 2 Submerged Cork-Keys UP into the central Row-3 Sluice Locks!

secondaryObjective.summary: Clear the stage without raising the flood gauge above 60%.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board; Top Keys start at Row 0 (cols 1, 6) falling down; Bottom Cork-Keys start at Row 6 (cols 2, 5) floating UP toward Row 3!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Row 3 holds 4 Sluice Lock receptacles guarded by 2-HP Bamboo Cages.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Stalks along the upper sluice catwalk at 1.8%/sec.

specialMechanics: Bidirectional Key Extraction: for the first time ever, Keys converge from BOTH top and bottom toward the middle row of the grid!
victoryCondition: Seat all 4 Keys into the Row-3 Sluice Locks before the Stilt Crawler reaches Mochi.
failureCondition: Danger reaches 100%.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Center-row Key exits fed simultaneously by downward gravity from above and upward buoyancy from below!

environmentDescription: Twilight monsoon levee shrouded in rain-mist, illuminated only by warm mason-jar firefly lanterns along a collapsing plank bridge.
rescueStory: Rain-mist hides the puzzle board while rising floodwater pushes Mochi's plank bridge upward against sharp overhead beams—drain the sluice fast!

mainObjective.summary: Clear 12 Rain-Mist Clouds, lower Floodwater by draining 70 Sluice Marbles, and repair 4 Bridge Planks.

secondaryObjective.summary: Trigger a Rainbow + Striped combo to light all levee lanterns at once.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color monsoon board; warning—using `TOOL_MONSOON_WATER_BLASTER` here adds +5% floodwater height, so prefer Gust Fan or Firefly Beacon!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Every 25 Sluice Marbles drained lowers the submerged water level by 1 full board row, restoring normal gravity!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Raises flood pressure at 1.9%/sec while spinning misted tiles.

specialMechanics: Dynamic Receding Waterline: as you drain Sluice Marbles (25 -> 50 -> 70), the floodwater visibly drops row-by-row on the 3D board!
victoryCondition: Clear 12 Mist Clouds, drain 70 Marbles, and rebuild 4 Planks before flood surge hits 100%.
failureCondition: Flood gauge reaches 100%.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Board physics evolve mid-level: draining marbles physically lowers the waterline row-by-row, flipping submerged rows back to normal downward gravity!

environmentDescription: Monumental brick-and-brass river barrage spanning surging turquoise waters with three giant counterweight floodgates.
rescueStory: Chapter 7 Finale! Mochi must cross the Great Barrage catwalk by cranking three Floodgates while Whirlpool Eels, Rotating Turbines, and Rising Tides test every river skill!

mainObjective.summary: Unlock 3 Brass Turbine Trunks, crank the Timed Flood Shutter >= 50%, and detonate 6 Special Candies.

secondaryObjective.summary: Finish with 6+ moves remaining.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color board combining 2 Rotating Turbine Gates, submerged rows 5–6, and 3 Brass Turbine Trunks.

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Hybrid turn + tide challenge; Riverboat Winch tool instantly boosts Shutter by +25%.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Hybrid pressure (26 moves / 72s) with 2x2 whirlpool spins.

specialMechanics: Hydro-Turbine Overdrive: firing a Striped blast through an open Rotating Turbine Gate spins the generator to crank +20% Shutter height at once!
victoryCondition: Open all 3 Brass Trunks and trigger 6 Specials with Flood Shutter >= 50%.
failureCondition: Out of moves or Flood Shutter seals shut.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Threading Striped lasers through open Rotating Turbine paddles supercharges the mechanical escape gate!

environmentDescription: Crisp sunlit Himalayan foothills with pine groves, stone viaduct arches, and a cheerful miniature blue steam-train waiting on a frosted siding.
rescueStory: Welcome to the Foothills! A Foothill Snow-Kulfi Golem is icing the miniature steam-train switch while a Prism Chameleon shifts colors on a pine branch!

mainObjective.summary: Shatter 12 Himalayan Frost Ice blocks and land 4 Color-Matched strikes on the Prism Chameleon to clear the train switch!

secondaryObjective.summary: Detonate 2 Golden Jilapi Coils to melt surrounding Ice in 1 hit.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color alpine board (Mandarin, Litchi, Mango, Jamun, Kulfi); `ENEMY_FROST_YETI_GOLEM` is IMMUNE to Freeze Blast—match warm Mandarin/Litchi/Jilapi pieces instead!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: 12 2-HP Frost Ice blocks encase the switch tracks; Jilapi ring-pulses melt 2 HP of Ice instantly!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Chapter-8 breather pace (29 moves): shifts its crest badge to a random board color each turn.

specialMechanics: Chameleon Color-Sync: matching the exact fruit color displayed on the Chameleon's crest fires a targeted beam that pushes both foothill creatures back!
victoryCondition: Clear 12 Frost Ice blocks and score 4 Color-Matched Chameleon hits within 29 moves.
failureCondition: Moves run out before toy-train switch clears.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Color-reactive enemy targeting: watching the Chameleon's live crest color tells you which candy color deals knockback on that turn!

environmentDescription: Resonant mountain railway tunnel lined with glittering amber rock-sugar veins and wooden support beams.
rescueStory: Careful with loud blasts! In this echoing tunnel, heavy 3x3 Bombs shake loose Falling Sugar-Shale pebbles from the ceiling—precision Striped lasers are king!

mainObjective.summary: Drop 3 Railway Lantern Keys and clear 10 Frost Ice tiles without burying the chutes in Shale Rockfall!

secondaryObjective.summary: Win while triggering <= 2 Rockfall tremors.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color foothill board introducing `OBS_LOOSE_SHALE_ROCKFALL`; Striped Candies cut cleanly with ZERO tremor, whereas Wrapped/Cluster Bombs shake down 2 top-row Shale Pebbles!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Keys start at row 1; reckless bombing drops Shale Pebbles right on top of your Keys!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Advances along the tunnel siding at 1.75%/sec and exhales frost every 10s.

specialMechanics: Surgical Laser Discipline: rewards 4-in-a-row Striped Candies and Prism Teleporter finesse over noisy area-of-effect bombs!
victoryCondition: Deliver all 3 Lantern Keys and clear 10 Frost Ice tiles before the Yeti blocks the tunnel.
failureCondition: Danger reaches 100%.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Seismic noise mechanic: explosive 3x3 bombs trigger ceiling rockfalls, elevating clean 4-match Striped surgery over brute blast spam!

environmentDescription: Breathtaking high-altitude ropeway cable car suspended between two snow-dusted mandarin ridges.
rescueStory: Mochi's bright red cable car stalled mid-gorge! High ridge gusts blow candies diagonally while a Clockwork Sentinel cranks a Piston Press on the tower!

mainObjective.summary: Jam 2 Tower Piston Crushers (6 hits), break 10 Iron Chains, and drain 65 Gorge Marbles to winch Mochi's cable car to the summit.

secondaryObjective.summary: Craft 2 Rainbow Color Bombs during the climb.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color board; unlocks `TOOL_SYRUP_CONDUIT_BRUSH` reward upon completion!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Wind shifts Row 3 rightward toward Crusher Column 5—careful not to let your Striped Candy drift under a slamming piston!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Turn-based precision challenge (26 moves): chains 2 tiles every 4th move.

specialMechanics: Wind-Assisted Crusher Jam: letting the Row-3 wind drift slide a Striped Candy INTO Column 5 on the Piston's telegraph turn auto-fires it to jam the press!
victoryCondition: Jam both Crushers (6 hits), snap 10 Chains, and drain 65 Marbles in 26 moves.
failureCondition: Moves run out mid-gorge.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Combining Wind Drift with Piston Timing: drifting a Special into a telegraphing Crusher lane jams the hazard hands-free!

environmentDescription: Dramatic mountain pass where a steaming hot-spring caramel flume meets an icy glacier ledge beneath a twin-arch bridge.
rescueStory: Fire and Ice! A Snow-Kulfi Golem stomps down the left ice ledge while a Sizzling Caramel Salamander races up the right hot-spring trench!

mainObjective.summary: Clear 10 Glacier Ice blocks, extinguish 10 Fire Embers, and unlock 2 Summit Brass Trunks.

secondaryObjective.summary: Bank 3 Striped lasers from the warm right half into the icy left half via Coconut Bumpers.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color board; Left cols 0–3 spawn chilly Ice; Right cols 4–7 spawn hot Fire Embers; 2 Coconut Bumpers route beams across the thermal divide!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Cross-routing warm beams left melts 2-HP Ice instantly; cross-routing cool Coconut beams right douses entire Ember rows!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Dual elemental advance at 1.9%/sec unless cross-countered.

specialMechanics: Cross-Hemisphere Elemental Routing: each half of the board holds the exact elemental counter needed to clear the opposite half twice as fast!
victoryCondition: Clear 10 Ice, 10 Fire, and both Brass Trunks before either creature reaches the bridge.
failureCondition: Thermal danger reaches 100%.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Asymmetric Fire-and-Ice board halves where cross-shooting lasers across the center divider deals 2x elemental weakness clears!

environmentDescription: High alpine observatory viaduct overlooking sunlit snow peaks, where the towering Kanchen-Frost Yeti Colossus blocks the mountain express!
rescueStory: BOSS ENCOUNTER 4! Kanchen-Frost freezes the outer puzzle columns and hurls twin Spiked Jawbreakers down the viaduct—use Rasgulla Trampolines to bounce his boulders right back into his ice armor!

mainObjective.summary: Shatter Kanchen-Frost's 240 HP Glacier Armor by rebounding 3 Boulders (via Rasgulla Orbs) and detonating 4 Warm Jilapi/Special combos!

secondaryObjective.summary: Defeat Kanchen-Frost with > 40% viaduct safety margin.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color alpine board featuring `CANDY_SPONGY_RASGULLA` and `CANDY_CRISPY_JILAPI`; Boss is immune to Cryo tools—warm combos & boulder rebounds deal huge damage!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Phase 1 freezes cols 0 & 7; Phase 2 adds Foothill Wind gusts and twin boulders.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: 2-Phase Colossus stomping at 1.6%/sec with Frost Breath & Boulder Hurls.

specialMechanics: Avalanche Counter-Volley: collecting 10 Rasgulla Orbs deploys a Spring Bumper on the viaduct that launches Kanchen-Frost's next boulder straight back for 50 Armor Damage!
victoryCondition: Reduce Kanchen-Frost's 240 HP to 0 via 3 Boulder Rebounds and 4 Warm Combos.
failureCondition: Viaduct crushed at 100% danger.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Boss is immune to Freeze tools—instead you harvest Rasgulla sponge candies to volley his own giant jawbreakers back at him!

environmentDescription: Joyful secular rural Fruit & Kite Carnival (Mela) decked with rainbow paper pinwheels, geometric painted borders, and fruit pavilions.
rescueStory: Welcome to the Harvest Carnival! Sparkling Refracting Quartz Prisms sit on the fairground board—hit one with a Striped laser and watch it split into FOUR beams!

mainObjective.summary: Fire 5 Prism-Split Laser Bursts to pop 14 Woven Bamboo Cages and unlock Mochi's Kite-Balloon tether!

secondaryObjective.summary: Chain both Quartz Prisms together in a single move!

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color festive board introducing `OBS_CRYSTAL_PRISM_MIRROR`: alternates each turn between Orthogonal (+) Cross-Split and Diagonal (X) Star-Split!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: 2 Quartz Prisms at (3,2) and (3,5) amplify any Striped blast into multi-axis fireworks!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Festive Chapter-9 breather (28 moves): Golla-Gulp samples fairground fruits beside the stall.

specialMechanics: Orthogonal-vs-Diagonal Prism Alternation: on odd moves Prisms fire + cross beams; on even moves they fire X diagonal beams into the corners!
victoryCondition: Trigger 5 Prism-Split Bursts and break 14 Cages within 28 moves.
failureCondition: Moves expire before Kite-Balloon lifts off.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Alternating + and X Refracting Quartz Prisms turn single Striped matches into celebratory full-board geometric laser shows!

environmentDescription: High above the carnival grounds where colorful diamond paper kites (ghuri) carry basket bridges between two wooden fairground towers.
rescueStory: Three Canopy Gliders are tangling Mochi's kite-bridge strings while a Prism Chameleon camouflages on the tower flagpole!

mainObjective.summary: Drop 4 Kite-Spool Keys, score 4 Color-Matched Chameleon hits, and shatter 2 Honeycomb Seals.

secondaryObjective.summary: Drop 2 Keys on the exact same turn.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color board; firing a Striped beam of the Chameleon's active color through a Quartz Prism counts as a Double Critical Hit!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Central Quartz Prism at (3,3) sits right between the two Queen Honeycomb clusters.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Gliders swoop for Spool Keys while Chameleon stalks at 1.85%/sec.

specialMechanics: Prism Snipe: hitting the central Prism on an even (X-diagonal) beat snipes BOTH Queen Honeycomb cells in the top corners simultaneously!
victoryCondition: Deliver 4 Spool Keys, land 4 Chameleon hits, and clear 2 Honeycombs before tether snap.
failureCondition: Danger reaches 100%.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Diagonal X-Prism geometry lets one well-timed center shot simultaneously snipe both corner Queen Honeycombs AND shoo Gliders!

environmentDescription: Hand-carved wooden village ferris wheel decked in marigold-colored ribbons and spinning fruit gondolas.
rescueStory: Mochi is riding Gondola #1 up to the top exit deck, but four Rotating Pinwheel Gates and a Sliding Terracotta Bar keep rearranging the chutes!

mainObjective.summary: Unlock 3 Brass Gondola Trunks and drain 75 Carnival Marbles within 25 strategic moves.

secondaryObjective.summary: Drain 25+ Marbles in a single cascade turn.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color board; pure turn-based masterwork combining 4 Rotating Gates + 1 Sliding Partition + 1 Quartz Prism!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Zero real-time stress—every single board mechanism moves deterministically on your swipe!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Advances 1 ferris-spoke per move (25 moves total).

specialMechanics: Deterministic Clockwork Symphony: clamping the open state with `TOOL_JACKFRUIT_RESIN_ANCHOR` lets a single Prism-Rainbow cascade drain 30+ Marbles!
victoryCondition: Open 3 Brass Trunks and drain 75 Marbles within 25 moves.
failureCondition: Clockwork Sentinel locks the wheel on move 25.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Grand clockwork puzzle box—every gate, slider, prism, and sentinel moves on exact deterministic turn beats with zero RNG timer panic!

environmentDescription: Festive twilight sweet-arcade Pavilion with sizzling Jilapi skillets, bouncing Rasgulla trampolines, and a Descending Stage Curtain!
rescueStory: The carnival finale curtain is lowering while a Jawbreaker Pangolin and Molten Salamander put on an unruly pyrotechnic show along Mochi's stage!

mainObjective.summary: Keep the Stage Shutter >= 45% open, trigger 6 Jilapi Ring Relays, and extinguish 12 Fire Embers!

secondaryObjective.summary: Finish with Stage Shutter >= 80% open!

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color board; 4 respawning Jilapi Relay pedestals amplify Prism-split lasers into massive overlapping ring bursts!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Prism at (3,4) feeds directly into 4 corner Jilapi Relays on even (X-diagonal) moves!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: High-tempo carnival rush at 1.95%/sec alongside spreading Fire Embers.

specialMechanics: Diagonal Prism-to-Jilapi Supernova: hitting the center Prism on an X-turn triggers ALL FOUR corner Jilapi Coils at once, cranking the Stage Curtain +35% open!
victoryCondition: Trigger 6 Jilapi Relays and douse 12 Embers while keeping Stage Shutter >= 45% open.
failureCondition: Curtain slams shut or Pangolin catches Mochi.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Center X-Prism wired to four corner Jilapi Coils rewards timing a single shot for a quadruple chain detonation!

environmentDescription: Centerpiece Brass Clockwork Carousel Pavilion towering above the fruit festival with giant spinning gears and confetti cannons.
rescueStory: BOSS ENCOUNTER 5! Charkha-Bot, the giant brass carnival automaton, has gone haywire—synchronizing two Piston Crushers and a Countdown Shutter to block Mochi's balloon!

mainObjective.summary: Overload Charkha-Bot's 260 HP dynamo using 4 Double-Special Combos while jamming 2 Piston Crushers and keeping the Escape Shutter >= 40%!

secondaryObjective.summary: Defeat Charkha-Bot within 22 moves!

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color board; Hybrid Boss (26 moves / 75s)—combining two adjacent Specials (e.g. Striped + Wrapped) short-circuits Charkha-Bot for 65 HP!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: 2 Quartz Prisms help clear chains quickly so you can pair adjacent Specials via Saffron Brush or Prism Teleporter!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: 2-Phase Clockwork Boss advancing on both move ticks and shutter countdown.

specialMechanics: Dynamo Short-Circuit: single matches tickle its brass armor, whereas swapping ANY two Special Candies together unleashes an overload arc for massive damage + 2-turn stun!
victoryCondition: Deplete 260 Boss HP and execute 4 Double-Special Combos with Shutter >= 40%.
failureCondition: Moves hit 0 or Escape Shutter closes.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Pure combo-crafting boss test: rewards pairing two Special Candies side-by-side to short-circuit heavy clockwork armor!

environmentDescription: Luminous subterranean jungle cavern inspired by Meghalaya & Bandarban hills, spanned by woven living-root bridges glowing with amethyst and quartz crystals.
rescueStory: Final Chapter! A Faceted Crystal Sentinel hovers before the Living-Root Bridge—its front mirror blocks vertical shots, so bank lasers into its unshielded flanks!

mainObjective.summary: Land 5 Side-Flank Laser Hits on the Crystal Sentinel (via Bumpers/Prisms) and collect 36 Tender Coconuts to hydrate the living-root bridge.

secondaryObjective.summary: Avoid firing vertical beams into the Sentinel's front mirror shield.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color crystal cavern board introducing `ENEMY_QUARTZ_WARDEN`—immune from below, 100% vulnerable to horizontal beams bent off Coconut Bumpers or + Prisms!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Coconut Bumpers on cols 0 & 7 bend vertical Striped shots horizontally right into the Warden's left/right core!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Chapter-10 tactical opener (28 moves): advances 1 root-knot per move.

specialMechanics: Flank-Only Geometry: teaches directional shield routing—vertical beams in cols 3–4 bounce off harmlessly, whereas outer-column bank shots pierce straight through!
victoryCondition: Deliver 5 Side-Flank Laser Hits and collect 36 Coconuts within 28 moves.
failureCondition: Sentinel reaches Mochi's root arch after move 28.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Directional boss-lite shield puzzle: frontal vertical attacks fail, requiring 90-degree lateral bank shots via side bumpers!

environmentDescription: Sparkling underground emerald waterfall feeding a crystal-clear cavern pool where submerged crystal rows meet refracting prisms!
rescueStory: Dual-gravity crystal waters submerge the lower cavern while BOTH a Crystal Sentinel and Whirlpool Eel guard the waterfall elevator!

mainObjective.summary: Converge 4 Crystal Elevator Keys (2 top-down, 2 bottom-up) to Row 3 and land 4 Flank Hits on the Crystal Sentinel!

secondaryObjective.summary: Let the Eel spin a Striped Candy into alignment with a Quartz Prism.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color cavern board combining Dual-Gravity `OBS_MONSOON_FLOOD_TIDE` (rows 4–6) with Row-3 `OBS_CRYSTAL_PRISM_MIRROR` nodes!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Row 3 hosts both the 4 Key Receptacles AND 2 Quartz Prisms!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Real-time cavern advance at 1.85%/sec with Eel whirlpool spins.

specialMechanics: Waterline Prism Nexus: because cascades from BOTH top and bottom collide at Row 3, the Row-3 Quartz Prisms trigger chain-split beams nearly every cascade!
victoryCondition: Seat all 4 Elevator Keys at Row 3 and land 4 Sentinel Flank Hits before capture.
failureCondition: Danger reaches 100%.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Placing Refracting Prisms right on the Dual-Gravity Waterline creates spectacular self-sustaining cascade fireworks!

environmentDescription: A vaulted octagonal mineral chamber lit by shifting rainbow shafts, housing three ancient secular Brass Explorer Trunks.
rescueStory: Two Twin Prism Chameleons guard the Explorer Vault while fragile Crystal Shale hangs overhead—use clean laser surgical precision to unlock all three Trunks!

mainObjective.summary: Unlock 3 Brass Explorer Trunks, land 6 Color-Synced Chameleon Hits, and clear 10 Glacier Crystal seals in 25 moves!

secondaryObjective.summary: Complete with 0 Shale Rockfall tremors triggered!

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color board with `OBS_LOOSE_SHALE_ROCKFALL`—avoid 3x3 Bombs; use Striped + Prism + Saffron Color Brush!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Octagonal board (4 corners cut) with central X/+ Prism routing color matches to all 3 Brass Trunks.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Turn-based precision test (25 moves): Twin Chameleons display 2 target colors each turn.

specialMechanics: Dual-Spectrum Sync: matching a color shared by BOTH a Brass Trunk clasp AND a Chameleon crest simultaneously unlocks the chest AND stuns the stalker!
victoryCondition: Open all 3 Explorer Trunks, score 6 Chameleon hits, and clear 10 Crystal Ice seals in 25 moves.
failureCondition: Moves reach 0 inside the vault.
uniqueGameplayTwist: High-IQ surgical puzzle combining seismic bomb restrictions with overlapping Trunk-and-Chameleon color targeting!

environmentDescription: A soaring crystal-arched suspension causeway leading directly to the Grand Sanctuary Gates above a glowing caramel-and-waterfall chasm.
rescueStory: Penultimate Survival Gauntlet! The Emerald Serpent, Crystal Sentinel, AND Closing Sanctuary Gate converge as Mochi makes her final dash to the Sanctum!

mainObjective.summary: Keep the Sanctuary Shutter >= 45% open, drop 3 Royal Sanctum Keys, drain 80 Crystal Marbles, and land 4 Flank Hits!

secondaryObjective.summary: Escape with Danger below 50% and Shutter >= 75%!

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color full-arsenal board featuring Prisms, Coconut Bumpers, Rotating Gates, and Jilapi Relays!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Every system learned across Chapters 1–10 works in harmony to generate huge cascade chains!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Elite Serpent + Sentinel pursuit at 2.0%/sec.

specialMechanics: Full-Arsenal Harmonic Chain: banking a Striped shot off a Coconut Bumper into a Quartz Prism triggers Jilapi Relays that simultaneously drain Marbles, flank the Sentinel, and crank the Shutter!
victoryCondition: Complete all 4 Causeway objectives while keeping Sanctuary Shutter >= 45% open.
failureCondition: Shutter closes or Serpent catches Mochi.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Rube-Goldberg laser circuit where one well-aimed bank shot chains Bumper -> Prism -> Jilapi Coil to advance all 4 objectives at once!

levelName: FINAL BOSS: Emperor Chroma-Fang's Prism Sanctum
environmentDescription: Breathtaking sunlit Crystal Jungle Amphitheater crowned by a rainbow waterfall terrace, living-root arches, and the Grand Golden Rescue Portal!
rescueStory: GRAND CAMPAIGN FINALE (Level 56)! Emperor Chroma-Fang—the Three-Headed Prism Serpent (Ruby Fire Head, Sapphire Frost Head, Emerald Slime Head)—blocks the Golden Portal in an epic 3-Phase showdown!

mainObjective.summary: Vanquish Emperor Chroma-Fang's 350 HP across 3 Phases: (1) Counter Fire/Ice/Slime Heads, (2) Route Dual-Gravity Prism Beams, and (3) Drop the Final Royal Key + Fire the 100% Rainbow Mega-Cannon!

secondaryObjective.summary: Land a Rainbow Bomb + Striped Candy mega-combo through a Quartz Prism to hit all 3 Serpent Heads simultaneously!

candyMatchingRequirement: Full 6-color Grand Finale palette (Himsagar Mango, Dinajpur Litchi, Tender Coconut, Monsoon Jamun, Pistachio Kulfi, Crispy Jilapi)!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Phase 1: Fire/Ice/Slime tri-hazards; Phase 2: Rows 5–6 submerge in Dual-Gravity Crystal Tide around 2 central Prisms; Phase 3: Spiral sprint for the Final Key!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: 3-Phase Ultimate Boss (350 HP) shifting arena physics at 65% and 30% HP thresholds!

specialMechanics: Tri-Elemental Prism Finale: routing a Rainbow + Striped combo into the central Quartz Prisms refracts elemental counter-beams into all 3 Hydra heads at once, charging the Golden Rescue Mega-Cannon!
victoryCondition: Deplete all 350 HP of Emperor Chroma-Fang, deliver the Final Royal Key, and fire the 100% Rainbow Mega-Cannon!
failureCondition: Chroma-Fang overtakes the Golden Portal terrace (Danger = 100%).
uniqueGameplayTwist: Three-stage evolving boss arena that synthesizes elemental counterplay, dual-gravity waterline cascades, and prism-refracted Rainbow mega-combos into one unforgettable climax!
